ZWE.note: Says donors and departments will contribute data, but names no link in use or being built to ID, payments or programmes.
Describes the registry only; no programme management system named.

facts.fact: The Herald reports the Zimbabwe Social Registry (ZISO) software is 85 percent complete per a Public Service ministry official, with a questionnaire to be piloted in four or five districts before data is uploaded.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare
